basic_details.job_title: WII Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Scientific Consultant, Non-Scientific Consultant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Two temporary project positions under Project Great Indian Bustard at the Wildlife Institute of India (WII), an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, are open to Indian nationals: Scientific Consultant (Young Professional) at Rs. 70,000 a month and Non-Scientific Consultant (Research Associate) at Rs. 40,000 a month, both consolidated. Both need a four-year Bachelor's Degree in Veterinary Sciences or higher with experience. Apply online at wiirp.com from 4 November 2026 to 18 November 2026; the project runs to 31 March 2029.

how_to_apply: Keep scanned copies ready in advance: educational qualification, marksheets, work experience, reserved category, UGC/CSIR NET, publications, other supporting documents, application processing fee receipt, passport size photo and digital signature.
Open the application portal at https://wiirp.com/application.php, or scan the QR code printed in the notice. No printed application copy will be considered.
Enter educational details strictly as per the mark sheets of the education board/university.

Pay the fee: General applicants Rs. 500 online; SC/ST/OBC/EWS and Physically Challenged applicants Rs. 100 as Application Processing Fee through Online Banking/ NEFT/ RTGS/ Electronic Mode, or by UPI using the QR code in the notice.
Upload the fee receipt in the online form. Failing to upload it leads to rejection.
To apply for a second position, submit a separate online form with supporting documents and fee for each position.

Bank details given for the fee: Account Name RRP Cell Revolving/ Director Wildlife Institute of India; Union Bank of India; Branch: Wildlife Institute of India, Chandrabani, Dehradun – 248 001; Account No. 518502010059776; IFSC Code UBIN0551856. The notice also allows payment from any bank by cash or demand draft using these details. Before paying electronically, confirm the account holder name “RRP CELL REVOLVING FUND/ Director Wildlife Institute of India”. The notice's contact details: 0135-2646232; +91 9456745562; [email protected], [email protected].
Proof of age and educational qualification
Research/work experience proof mentioning start and end tenure dates, from employer/guide/supervisor
Reserved category certificate, UGC/CSIR NET and publications (as applicable)

No Objection Certificate, not more than one month older than the last date of application, for candidates presently working or engaged with any WII project or research activity and for Ph.D. scholars, from the Project Investigator/Supervisor/Nodal Officer
No Dues certificate from WII for candidates who earlier worked at WII
important_instructions: Incomplete applications, such as those without proof for age, qualification, experience, photograph, signature or fee receipt, are liable to be rejected. A candidate may apply for a maximum of two advertised positions, relevant to his/her academic education and the essential and desirable requisites of the position. The application/processing fee is non-refundable once paid, even if the application is rejected or not shortlisted or the applicant withdraws. Selected candidates must produce all original documents/certificates at the time of joining. An applicant found to have wilfully concealed, misrepresented or canvassed facts will not be considered for selection or will be terminated, and due action will be taken. Canvassing in any form is liable to rejection of the candidature. The Institute's decision on eligibility, acceptance or rejection and mode of selection is final and binding. No inquiry or correspondence from any individual or agency will be entertained. The Director, WII, reserves the right to reject any application with or without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: The Wildlife Institute of India is an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India. The notice describes it as offering training programmes, academic courses and advisory in wildlife research and management. Its Recruitment and Placement Cell is at Chandrabani, Dehradun, Uttarakhand-248002.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for 2 Project Consultant temporary positions, one in each post. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals may apply. Age limit is 35 years for both posts. The notice prints no date for counting age. Upper-age relaxation follows the Government of India DoPT OM No. 15012/2/2010-Estt. (D) dated 27.03.2012, as amended from time to time. At present it is up to 5 years for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes and up to 3 years for Other Backward Class (OBC). Essential: Master's Degree in Veterinary Science including the four years Bachelor's Degree in Veterinary Sciences from a recognized institute/University as minimum qualification, AND more than three years of experience in R&D in Industrials or Science & Technology Institutions or Scientific activities and Services. OR: Bachelor's Degree (four years) in Veterinary Sciences from a recognized institute/University as minimum qualification, AND more than five years of experience in R&D in Industrials or Science & Technology Institutions or Scientific activities and Services. Desirable: Experience in bird husbandry, avian surgery, dog sterilization and wildlife handling. Note: a one year internship period certificate of BVSc / MVSc will be considered as one year working experience. Essential: Four years Bachelor's Degree in Veterinary Sciences from a recognized institute/University as minimum qualification, AND more than one years of experience in R&D in Industrials or Science & Technology Institutions or Scientific activities and Services. Desirable: Experience in bird husbandry, avian surgery, dog sterilization and wildlife handling. Note: a one year internship period certificate of BVSc / MVSc will be considered as one year working experience.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Scientific Consultant (Young Professional) receives Rs. 70,000 and the Non-Scientific Consultant (Research Associate) receives Rs. 40,000, both consolidated monthly emoluments. The project duration is 31 March 2029, annual renewable based on performance review. The positions are purely temporary for the project period and stand abolished after the project is completed. The Institute's rules and regulations govern the project's tenure and the code of conduct of selected candidates. The notice also says candidates not found suitable for a post may be considered for a position at a lower grade on the recommendation of the Interview Committee, with approval of the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: WII Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints the same description of work for both posts: Bustard Husbandry and Management Fieldwork (including trapping of birds and animals) Clinical Case Treatment in Conservation Breeding Centers in Rajasthan

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants are shortlisted for an online interview on essential qualification, age limit, percentage of marks in Bachelor's/Master's Degree, specialization relevance in Masters, research experience and publications (papers published in journals and books, papers presented in workshops, seminars, symposiums or conferences), as per WII rules. Shortlisted candidates are then scored out of 50 marks: The top ten shortlisted candidates for each position are called for interview. A duly constituted Selection Committee conducts the process. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not automatically entitle an applicant to an interview. The list of shortlisted candidates and the interview result will be uploaded in the “Latest News & Announcements” section of the Institute's website at https://wii.gov.in/news . Selected candidates must join immediately within the duration given in the Offer Letter.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in WII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 temporary project positions under Project Great Indian Bustard: one Scientific Consultant (Young Professional) and one Non-Scientific Consultant (Research Associate).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for WII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 18 November 2026. Applications open on 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Scientific Consultant post?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree in Veterinary Science including the four years Bachelor's Degree in Veterinary Sciences plus more than three years of R&D experience, OR a four-year Bachelor's Degree in Veterinary Sciences plus more than five years of such experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: A four years Bachelor's Degree in Veterinary Sciences from a recognized institute/University and more than one years of experience in R&D in Industrials or Science & Technology Institutions or Scientific activities and Services.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for WII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years for both posts. Relaxation is up to 5 years for SC/ST and up to 3 years for OBC.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: The Scientific Consultant (Young Professional) gets Rs. 70,000 and the Non-Scientific Consultant (Research Associate) gets Rs. 40,000, both consolidated monthly emoluments.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: General category applicants pay Rs. 500. SC/ST/OBC/EWS and Physically Challenged applicants are exempted from the application fee but pay Rs. 100 as Application Processing Fee. The fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the online application form at https://wiirp.com/application.php, or reach it through the QR code in the notice, and upload the documents and fee receipt. No printed application copy is considered.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Applicants are shortlisted on a 50-mark screening (25 for percentage of marks, 25 for specialization relevance). The top ten shortlisted candidates for each position are called for online interview before the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job, and can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: No, the positions are purely temporary for the project period, which runs to 31 March 2029 (annual renewable based on performance review). A candidate may apply for a maximum of two positions, with a separate form and fee for each.
